title: Average latency includes idle sessions
description: Fix the query. For each database_name calculate avg_duration_sec using only state = active. Databases with no active sessions are omitted. Return exactly two columns: database_name, avg_duration_sec rounded to one decimal. Sort by avg_duration_sec DESC, then database_name ASC.
starter_sql:
SELECT database_name, ROUND(AVG(duration_sec), 1) AS avg_duration_sec
FROM sessions
GROUP BY database_name
ORDER BY avg_duration_sec DESC, database_name ASC;
hints: The current AVG sees every state.
Filter active rows before GROUP BY.
solution_explanation: WHERE state = active forms the correct row set before aggregation.
